body.message:
We would like to sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience regarding the refund.

As per the latest update from our Finance Team, unfortunately, they are unable to process the one-night refund via bank transfer due to a limitation with the transfer process.

If it is convenient for you, would you be able to visit our office to collect the refund directly? We truly appreciate your understanding and cooperation, and we apologize again for any inconvenience this may cause.

Please let us know if visiting the office would be possible for you, so we can make the necessary arrangements.
